f-distribution.pseudocode:
def anova_f(groups):  # 일원분산분석 F 통계량
    all_x = [x for g in groups for x in g]
    k, n = len(groups), len(all_x)
    grand = sum(all_x) / n
    means = [sum(g) / len(g) for g in groups]
    ssb = sum(len(g) * (m - grand) ** 2
              for g, m in zip(groups, means))  # 집단 간
    ssw = sum((x - m) ** 2
              for g, m in zip(groups, means) for x in g)
    msb = ssb / (k - 1)  # 자유도 d1 = k − 1
    msw = ssw / (n - k)  # 자유도 d2 = n − k
    return msb / msw  # F(d1, d2) 임계값과 비교
